title: A Queen for One Square
setup: White has just dropped a rook from d2 to the back rank, and only the rook on f1 still watches f2.
hint: Your knight on h3 already covers g1; ask what would happen if a white rook were forced to stand there.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qg1+}} cannot be answered by the king, because the knight on h3 defends g1. So {{Rxg1}} is forced, and the recapture fills the very square the king needed. {{Nf2#}} then lands where the rook, the king and both pawns all look straight past it.
